primitives.name: Distinction
primitives.statement: There exist realizations x and y that are not mutually reachable.
primitives.operational_definition: Exists x,y such that not (xRy and yRx).

primitives.name: Relation
primitives.statement: A directed edge relation E may hold among realizations.
primitives.operational_definition: E is a subset of V x V.

primitives.name: Transformation
primitives.statement: Finite compositions of admissible directed edges define reachability.
primitives.operational_definition: R is the reflexive-transitive closure of E.

definitions.name: Reachability
definitions.statement: xRy iff a finite directed path, including length zero, connects x to y.

definitions.name: QuotientClass
definitions.statement: [x] is the equivalence class of x under mutual reachability.

claims.statement: Strict precedence on mutual-reachability quotient classes is a strict partial order.
For finite quotient sets, there exists an injective integer-valued order-preserving ranking.
No strict precedence cycle exists in the mutual-reachability quotient.
Distinction is not necessary for T1; a singleton identity model is a witness.

observables.name: ReachabilityQuery
observables.definition: Whether an admissible finite path exists from x to y.

observables.name: QuotientRank
observables.definition: An integer topological rank assigned to a quotient class in a finite model.

falsifiers.condition: Construct a model satisfying the formal R2 reachability definitions where quotient strict precedence is not irreflexive or transitive.
Construct a finite strict quotient order that has no injective order-preserving map into a finite integer chain.

metadata.purpose: First formalized Omega toy model with proved order-theoretic claims.
